column2: t６０８／ジャハルッカス／戦闘前

column4: 通路を進む・・途中で振動が何度か聞こえる
column5: We proceeded down the passage... several vibrations were felt along the way.

column4: 案内のホルスがジャハルッカスの説明
column5: Horus, our guide, explained about Jhahlckas.

column4: ランスさん、そうでね、貴方方のお父さんが前に倒しました
column5: Rance-san, yes, your father defeated him before.

column4: だが、復活してしまった、理由は分からないがこの星の悪魔と契約を結んだらしい
column5: But he revived; the reason is unknown, but it seems he made a contract with a demon of this planet.

column4: 巨大なジャハルッカスとアームズが戦っている
column5: The gigantic Jhahlckas and Arms are fighting.

column4: が、明らかにアームズが押されている
column5: But clearly, Arms is being pushed back.

column4: アームズが倒れた（悪性けほけほ病のせいでなく実力で負けた）
column5: Arms fell (not because of the malignant cough disease, but defeated by power).

column4: 入れ替わるようにエール達がジャハルッカスの前に立ち塞がる
column5: El and the others stepped up to block Jhahlckas as if replacing him.

column4: お久しぶりです、ここは任せて下さい
column5: Long time no see, leave this to us.
